## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:

- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly.     name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

44	─────────────────                      ──────────────────────
45	ConvNet(nn.Module)          ──保留──▶  PyTorchModel(nn.Module)   ← 模型本体，几乎原样
46	model.to(device) 手工搬运    ──消失──▶  Trainer(accelerator="auto") 自动搬运

53	```

247	**注意一个真实的坑**：[L34](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/templates/pytorch_lightning/tune_classification_basic.py#L34) 写的是 `parser.add_argument("--learning_rate", type=int, default=0.005, ...)`——`type=int`！argparse 对非字符串的 default 不做类型转换，所以不传参时 `0.005` 有效；但从命令行传小数（如 `--learning_rate 0.001`）会触发 `int("0.001")` 抛 `ValueError`，只有整数能通过。这是「读源码以代码为准」的又一实例（u3-l5、u7-l4 已遇过同类问题），复用该脚本时应改成 `type=float`。
248	
249	**（b）三件套与 notebook 逐字对应**
250	
251	- `PyTorchModel`（[L47-L69](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/templates/pytorch_lightning/tune_classification_basic.py#L47-L69)）：一个按 `hidden_units` 元组循环搭建 `Linear+ReLU` 的通用 MLP，`torch.flatten(x, start_dim=1)` 让它能吃图像输入——演示了「模板换模型只换这一段」。
252	- `LightningModel`（[L77-L146](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/templates/pytorch_lightning/tune_classification_basic.py#L77-L146)）：与 4.1.3（c）精读的 notebook 版逐字相同（save_hyperparameters、三个 torchmetrics.Accuracy、_shared_step、三个 step、configure_optimizers）。
253	- `DataModule`（[L154-L210](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/templates/pytorch_lightning/tune_classification_basic.py#L154-L210)）：MNIST + random_split(55000/5000) + 三 loader，与 cnn-basic 的 L515-L572 相同。
254	
255	**（c）初始化、Trainer 与收尾**
256	
257	[L217-L227](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/templates/pytorch_lightning/tune_classification_basic.py#L217-L227) 实例化 `PyTorchModel(input_size=28*28, hidden_units=(128, 256), num_classes=10)`、`LightningModel`、`ModelCheckpoint(monitor="valid_acc")`、`CSVLogger` 与 `DataModule`；[L229-L238](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/templates/pytorch_lightning/tune_classification_basic.py#L229-L238) 的 Trainer 与 notebook 版几乎相同，唯一实质差异是 **`deterministic=True`**（cnn-basic notebook 里是 `False`）——批量调参追求可比性，牺牲一点速度换取逐位复现（u4-l4 讲过该权衡：仓库实测开确定性对耗时几乎无影响）。最后 [L244-L250](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/templates/pytorch_lightning/tune_classification_basic.py#L244-L250)：`trainer.fit` → 打印训练耗时 → `trainer.test(ckpt_path="best")` 直接输出最优模型成绩，脚本结束。没有画图、没有失败案例展示——批量场景下结论只看数字。
258	
259	**（d）submit_command.sh：网格扫描的提交方式**
260	
261	[templates/pytorch_lightning/submit_command.sh:L1-L8](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/templates/pytorch_lightning/submit_command.sh#L1-L8) 用 Gradient 平台的 `grid run` 提交：`--instance_type 2_m60_8gb --gpus 2` 指定双 M60 GPU 的实例，随后把 `--learning_rate` 传成 6 个值的 JSON 列表、`--batch_size` 传成 3 个值的列表、`--epochs 20`。grid 会把列表参数做笛卡尔积，自动展开成 \(6 \times 3 = 18\) 个独立实验，每个实验各自的 `logs/my-model/version_N/metrics.csv` 记录了完整曲线，事后汇总即可选出最优超参组合。没有 Gradient 账户也不影响——`grid run` 只是批量启动器，本地用 `python tune_classification_basic.py` 配 shell 循环可达到同样效果。
262	
263	#### 4.3.4 代码实践
264	
265	**实践目标**：验证 tune 脚本可在本地命令行跑通，并亲手复现 4.3.3（a）指出的 argparse 类型坑。
266	
267	**操作步骤**：
268	
269	1. 在本地（或 CPU 环境）进入 `templates/pytorch_lightning/` 目录，先运行最小配置：
270	   ```bash
271	   python tune_classification_basic.py --batch_size 64 --epochs 1 --workers 0 --learning_rate 1
272	   ```
273	   （MNIST 会自动下载到 `./data`；`--workers 0` 规避多进程数据加载的文件句柄问题。）
274	2. 观察 `logs/my-model/version_0/` 下生成的 `metrics.csv` 与 checkpoint 文件。
275	3. 再故意运行 `python tune_classification_basic.py --epochs 1 --learning_rate 0.005`，观察报错。
276	4. 把 L34 的 `type=int` 改为 `type=float`（改自己机器上的副本），重跑第 3 步命令。
277	
278	**需要观察的现象**：第 1 步正常训练 1 个 epoch 并打印 `test_acc`（MLP + Adam 在 MNIST 上 1 个 epoch 通常可达 95% 左右，具体数值**待本地验证**）；第 3 步抛出 `ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: '0.005'`；第 4 步修复后可正常传入小数学习率。
279	
280	**预期结果**：确认「default 不经 type 转换、命令行值必经 type 转换」的 argparse 行为；确认脚本的 CSVLogger 产物结构与 notebook 版一致。
281	
282	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
283	
284	**练习 1**：tune 脚本与模板 notebook 的三件套代码逐字相同，除了超参来源和结尾部分。列出所有让你确认「这是同一套代码」的证据，以及两处实质差异。
285	
286	**答案**：证据——`LightningModel`（脚本 L77-L146）与 cnn-basic notebook L213-L282 内容一致；`DataModule`（L154-L210）与 notebook L515-L572 一致；`ModelCheckpoint(monitor="valid_acc")` + `CSVLogger("logs/", "my-model")` 的组织方式一致。实质差异：①超参从 notebook 顶部硬编码变量变为 argparse 参数（L29-L39）；②Trainer 的 `deterministic` 从 notebook 版的 `False` 变为 `True`（L236），且脚本结尾只 fit + test，省去画图与失败案例分析。
287	
288	**练习 2**：为什么脚本要在文件开头 `pip install torchmetrics`，而 notebook 不用？
289	
290	**答案**：notebook 有人交互，缺包时报错可以现场处理；脚本的典型运行环境是云端刚启动的裸实例（见 submit_command.sh 的 `--instance_type`），无人值守，缺包即整个实验失败。`subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", ...])` 用当前解释器自举安装，保证批量任务不因环境缺包而中断。这也是一种幂等设计——已安装时 pip 快速跳过。
291	
292	**练习 3**：如果想在 18 组网格结果中选最优超参，你应该比较哪个数字：每组实验的 `test_acc`，还是 `valid_acc`？为什么？
293	
294	**答案**：选超参应看 `valid_acc`（或最优 checkpoint 对应的验证指标）。`test_acc` 只应在最终选定超参、全量重训后评估一次（u7-l2 的纪律：测试集只用一次）。若直接用 18 组的 test_acc 挑最大，等于让测试集参与了超参选择，其成绩会对真实泛化性能给出乐观偏倚的估计。脚本的 CSVLogger 恰好把 `valid_acc` 逐 epoch 记入 metrics.csv，方便事后比较。
295	
296	## 5. 综合实践
297	
298	**任务：把 `cnn-resnet34-mnist` 从纯 PyTorch 版迁移为 Lightning 版并跑通。**
299	
300	背景核查（已由本讲验证）：`pytorch-lightning_ipynb/cnn/` 目录下**没有**任何 resnet notebook（现有 18 份：alexnet、allconv、basic、densenet121、he-init、lenet5、mobilenet、nin、vgg 等），而 `pytorch_ipynb/cnn/` 下有 `cnn-resnet18/34/50-mnist.ipynb` 等多份——这正是「尚无 Lightning 版本的模型」。
301	
302	实施步骤：
303	
304	1. **复制模板**：把 `pytorch-lightning_ipynb/mlp/template_classification_basic.ipynb` 复制为工作目录下的 `cnn-resnet34-mnist-lightning.ipynb`（不要提交到仓库）。

306	3. **填公共段**：从 Lightning 版 cnn-basic 复制 `LightningModel`（L213-L282）与 MNIST `DataModule`（L515-L572）替换模板中对应 `%load` cell；`pytorch_model = PyTorchModel(num_blocks=[3,4,6,3], ...)` 按原 notebook 的 ResNet-34 配置填参。
307	4. **填杂项**：标题、描述、`class_dict = {0:'0', ..., 9:'9'}`。
308	5. **跑通**：`NUM_EPOCHS = 1` 先验证整条流水线（fit → test → 失败案例 → 混淆矩阵）；成功后再训练完整 epoch 数。
309	6. **对照**：与纯 PyTorch 版 cnn-resnet34-mnist 的测试准确率对比（u3-l4 提到 ResNet-18 在 MNIST 约 99.06%，可作参考量级），并按 4.1.5 练习 3 的标准检查两版配方是否对齐。
310	
311	预期结果：1 个 epoch 内 `valid_acc` 正常爬升、`trainer.test(ckpt_path='best')` 输出 `test_acc`（具体数值待本地验证）；整份 notebook 除 UNIQUE MODEL CODE 与实例化参数外与 cnn-basic 结构逐段相同——这正说明你已掌握本讲的模板化工作流。
312	
313	## 6. 本讲小结
314	
315	- **风格对照迁移**：Lightning 版与纯 PyTorch版的模型本体几乎逐字相同（保持 `nn.Module`、forward 只返回 logits）；消失的是设备搬运、手写双层循环、手写准确率函数，它们分别变成 `Trainer(accelerator="auto")`、`training_step + trainer.fit`、`torchmetrics.Accuracy`；新增的是验证集（`random_split`）、`ModelCheckpoint` 按验证准确率选优与 CSVLogger 结构化日志。

317	- **模板中的 `%load` 引用的 `code_lightningmodule/`、`code_dataset/` 目录在当前仓库已不存在**，使用模板时需从现役 notebook（如 cnn-basic）复制对应代码段；现役 notebook 中的 `# %load` 注释是共享代码时代的来源痕迹。
318	- **tune 脚本是模板的 .py 化**：三件套逐字相同，超参改由 argparse 传入，开头自举安装 torchmetrics，`deterministic=True` 换取逐位复现，结尾只 fit + test；配合 `submit_command.sh` 的 `grid run` 可把参数列表展开成 6×3=18 组网格实验。

320	- **对照两版成绩时先查配方**：cnn-basic 两版的优化器（SGD/Adam）、学习率（0.05/0.005）、epoch 数（10/20）均不相同，97.97% vs 98.79% 的差异不能归因于框架。
321	
322	## 7. 下一步学习建议
323	
324	- **下一讲（u8-l3）**：数据增强实战（AutoAugment 与 TrivialAugment）——同样基于 pytorch-lightning 目录，将看到 Lightning 版实验如何组织「无增强/两种增强」的三方对照，本讲的模板化视角会让你一眼看出三份 notebook 只差 transform 一处。

# Lightning 模型库对照与官方模板

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u8-l1）我们已经在一份 notebook 里学会了 LightningModule、DataModule、Trainer 与 ModelCheckpoint 的用法。本讲回答三个更「工程化」的问题：

1. **对照迁移**：给定一份纯 PyTorch 版 notebook（`pytorch_ipynb/`），如何机械地把它改写成 Lightning 版（`pytorch-lightning_ipynb/`）？两套风格的每一行代码如何一一映射？
2. **模板化**：作者如何保证几十份 Lightning notebook 结构完全一致？学会使用 `templates/pytorch_lightning/` 的分类模板 notebook，把「填空题」做出来。
3. **脚本化**：如何脱离 Jupyter，用命令行脚本批量启动超参扫描实验？

学完后，你应该能独立把 zoo 中任何一个「尚无 Lightning 版」的模型（例如 ResNet）迁移成 Lightning 版并跑通训练。

## 2. 前置知识

- **u8-l1 的 Lightning 三件套**：`LightningModule`（写每一步的训练逻辑）、`LightningDataModule`（封装数据下载/划分/加载）、`Trainer`（接管 epoch 循环、反向传播、设备搬运）。本讲不重复其内部机制，直接使用。
- **同名对齐约定（u1-l1）**：同一模型在 `pytorch_ipynb/` 与 `pytorch-lightning_ipynb/` 下文件名相同，例如 `cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb` 在两个目录各有一份，是同一模型的两种框架风格实现。README 中徽章数量即版本数。
- **五步训练范式（u2-l1 起）**：forward → loss → zero_grad → backward → step。Lightning 把后四步藏进 `Trainer`，但范式没变。
- **`%load` 魔法命令**：Jupyter 中 `%load path.py` 会把指定文件的内容载入当前 cell（原命令变为 `# %load ...` 注释）。后文会讲到，仓库模板中该命令引用的目录如今已不存在，需要手动处理。
- **argparse**：Python 标准库的命令行参数解析器，`parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=10)` 定义参数，`args = parser.parse_args()` 解析。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `pytorch_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb` | 纯 PyTorch 版基础 CNN，本讲的「对照物」 |
| `pytorch-lightning_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb` | Lightning 版同名 notebook，对照迁移的目标形态 |
| `pytorch-lightning_ipynb/mlp/template_classification_basic.ipynb` | zoo 目录内的分类模板 notebook（占位符版） |
| `templates/pytorch_lightning/template_classification_basic.ipynb` | 官方模板目录下的同一份模板（与上一份几乎相同） |
| `templates/pytorch_lightning/tune_classification_basic.py` | 命令行训练/调参脚本（模板的 .py 化） |
| `templates/pytorch_lightning/submit_command.sh` | 在 Gradient 云平台批量提交超参网格的命令 |

> 提示：`.ipynb` 是 JSON 文件，本文给出的行号均指该 JSON 源文件中的行号（可在 GitHub 页面或文本编辑器中直接定位）。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 风格对照迁移：同一模型的两套写法

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

仓库里 121 份纯 PyTorch notebook 与 39 份 Lightning notebook 覆盖的模型高度重叠。把前者改写成后者，不需要重写模型——**模型本体保持纯 PyTorch，Lightning 只负责包装**。这是 `pytorch-lightning_ipynb` 所有 notebook 的统一架构决策：

```
纯 PyTorch notebook                    Lightning notebook
─────────────────                      ──────────────────────
ConvNet(nn.Module)          ──保留──▶  PyTorchModel(nn.Module)   ← 模型本体，几乎原样
model.to(device) 手工搬运    ──消失──▶  Trainer(accelerator="auto") 自动搬运
手写 epoch×batch 双层循环    ──消失──▶  LightningModel.training_step + trainer.fit
compute_accuracy 手写函数    ──替换──▶  torchmetrics.Accuracy 指标对象
train/test 两个 loader      ──升级──▶  DataModule 三 loader（含验证集）
优化器与训练循环纠缠         ──解耦──▶  configure_optimizers 单独声明
训练结束测最终权重           ──升级──▶  ModelCheckpoint 按验证准确率存最优
print 打日志                ──替换──▶  CSVLogger + metrics.csv + pandas 画图
```

理解这张映射表后，迁移就变成机械操作：**抄模型、删循环、包 LightningModule、换 DataModule、一行 fit**。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

以 cnn-basic 为例，迁移的执行顺序：

1. **搬模型**：把纯 PyTorch 版的模型类复制过来，命名为 `PyTorchModel`，`forward` 只返回 logits（不再返回 probas）。
2. **写包装**：定义 `LightningModel(pl.LightningModule)`，把模型对象与学习率作为构造参数传入；实现 `_shared_step`、`training_step`、`validation_step`、`test_step`、`configure_optimizers`。
3. **换数据**：把手写的 `train_loader`/`test_loader` 改写为 `DataModule(pl.LightningDataModule)`，`setup` 里用 `random_split` 切出验证集。
4. **配外设**：`ModelCheckpoint` 回调 + `CSVLogger`。
5. **一键训练**：`trainer = pl.Trainer(...)` → `trainer.fit(model, datamodule=...)` → `trainer.test(..., ckpt_path='best')`。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**（a）对照物：纯 PyTorch 版的「一切都要自己管」**

纯 PyTorch 版在同一个 cell 里完成模型定义、设备搬运与优化器构造：device 需要手工选择（作者机器上是 `cuda:3`），模型与优化器绑定在一起，见 [pytorch_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb:L102-L105](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb#L102-L105) 中 device 与 random_seed 的设置。

模型类 `ConvNet` 定义于 [pytorch_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb:L163-L224](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb#L163-L224)：`__init__` 里逐层创建 conv/pool/linear，`forward` 末尾 `return logits, probas` 同时返回 logits 和 softmax 概率；L220-L224 紧接着实例化模型并创建 SGD 优化器。注意它还演示了不推荐的高斯初始化（`m.weight.data.normal_(0.0, 0.01)`）。

训练循环完全手写：`compute_accuracy` 自行统计正确数（[L368](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb#L368)），epoch×batch 双层 `for` 循环起于 [L381](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb#L381)，循环体内每一步都要手工 `features.to(device)`、前向（L389）、`optimizer.zero_grad()`（L391）、backward、step、print 日志。评估阶段在 [L436](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb#L436) 直接对**最终权重**测一次准确率（97.97%），没有验证集、没有最优 checkpoint。

**（b）Lightning 版：模型本体原样保留**

Lightning 版的第一个关键点：**模型类不继承 LightningModule，仍是纯 PyTorch**。`PyTorchModel` 定义于 [pytorch-lightning_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb:L149-L197](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch-lightning_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb#L149-L197)，网络结构与纯 PyTorch 版完全相同（同样的 8/16 通道两层卷积、`7*7*16` 分类头），只有两处差异：层用 `nn.Sequential` 组织得更紧凑；**`forward` 只返回 logits**。这是因为下游的 `cross_entropy` 与 `argmax` 都只需要 logits，softmax 概率是多余的（softmax 是单调的，argmax 结果不变——u2-l2 已论证）。

**（c）LightningModel：把「训练一台机器需要的所有零件」装进一个类**

[pytorch-lightning_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb:L213-L282](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch-lightning_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb#L213-L282) 是 Lightning 版的包装类，逐段看：

- 构造函数接收 `(model, learning_rate)`，用 `save_hyperparameters(ignore=["model"])`（L225）把超参记入日志目录但跳过模型参数本身；再创建三个 `torchmetrics.Accuracy` 实例分别服务 train/valid/test 三阶段。
- `_shared_step`（L239-L245）把「前向 → 交叉熵 → argmax」打包成一个函数，三个 step 方法复用它——这正是 u8-l1 讲过的 `_shared_step` 复用模式。
- `training_step`（L247-L261）：算损失并 `self.log("train_loss", loss)`；随后有个值得注意的细节——为了在训练曲线上画出「eval 模式下的训练准确率」，它临时 `self.model.eval()` + `torch.no_grad()` 再前向一次，用完切回 `self.model.train()`。这相当于把 u2-l4 讲的 train/eval 双模式切换写进了训练步。
- `validation_step`（L263）与 `test_step`（L275）结构相同，只更新各自的指标对象并以 `on_epoch=True` 记录 epoch 级指标。
- `configure_optimizers`（L280-L282）单独声明 Adam 优化器。注意对照差异：**纯 PyTorch 版用 SGD + lr 0.05，Lightning 版用 Adam + lr 0.005**，两版超参并不对齐（学习率见 [L105-L108](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch-lightning_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb#L105-L108) 的 `LEARNING_RATE = 0.005`），对照实验时须留意。

**（d）DataModule：两个 loader 变三个**

[pytorch-lightning_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb:L515-L572](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch-lightning_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb#L515-L572) 的 `DataModule`：`prepare_data`（L520）只负责下载；`setup`（L524）加载数据并用 `random_split` 把 60000 张训练图切成 55000/5000 的训练/验证两份——**纯 PyTorch 版根本没有验证集**，这是 Lightning 版新增的实验纪律；`train_dataloader`/`val_dataloader`/`test_dataloader`（L543/L553/L563）分别返回三个 loader，训练 loader `shuffle=True, drop_last=True`，其余两个保持确定顺序。

**（e）Trainer：五行换掉四十行循环**

训练配置在 [pytorch-lightning_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb:L637-L645](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch-lightning_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb#L637-L645)（`LightningModel` 实例化 + `ModelCheckpoint(save_top_k=1, mode="max", monitor="valid_acc")` + `CSVLogger`）与 [L1006-L1018](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch-lightning_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb#L1006-L1018)（`pl.Trainer(max_epochs=..., accelerator="auto", devices="auto", ...)` 与 `trainer.fit`）。对比纯 PyTorch 版 L381-L417 的手写循环：设备搬运、epoch 迭代、backward 三件套、模式切换全部消失。评估用 [L1167](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch-lightning_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb#L1167) 的 `trainer.test(..., ckpt_path='best')` 自动加载验证准确率最高的 checkpoint（测试准确率 98.79%）；推理则可用 [L1213](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch-lightning_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb#L1213) 的 `LightningModel.load_from_checkpoint(path, model=pytorch_model)` 从文件重建。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：纯 PyTorch 版 forward 返回 `(logits, probas)`，Lightning 版只返回 `logits`。为什么可以这样删？删掉后哪两处代码不受影响、哪一处受益？

**答案**：`F.cross_entropy` 只接受 logits（内部做数值稳定的 log_softmax，u2-l2）；`torch.argmax(logits, dim=1)` 与对 softmax 概率取 argmax 结果完全相同（softmax 单调保序）。因此损失计算与预测都不受影响。受益的是 `forward` 若要被 `Trainer.predict` 复用（[L213-L282](https://github.com/rasbt/deeplearning-models/blob/59beda3aa25337e576564f1c18c6edd26f9f30e3/pytorch-lightning_ipynb/cnn/cnn-basic.ipynb#L213-L282) 中 LightningModel.forward 直接转发模型输出），返回单一 logits 接口更干净。

**练习 2**：Lightning 版为什么能在纯 PyTorch 版的基础上「凭空」多出一个验证集，而模型与损失函数一行不改？

**答案**：因为验证集只改变数据供给（`DataModule.setup` 里 `random_split` 切出 5000 张、`val_dataloader` 提供加载）与训练调度（`validation_step` 在每个 epoch 后被 Trainer 调用、`ModelCheckpoint` 据此选优），都属于 Trainer 与 DataModule 的职责范围；模型 forward 与损失计算对「数据来自哪个 loader」无感知。

**练习 3**：两版 notebook 的测试准确率分别是 97.97% 与 98.79%，能否据此得出「Lightning 训练效果更好」？

**答案**：不能。两版至少有三处混淆变量：优化器不同（SGD vs Adam）、学习率不同（0.05 vs 0.005）、epoch 数不同（10 vs 20），且 Lightning 版报告的是验证集选优后的 best checkpoint 成绩。这与 u3-l5 的结论一致：单次运行、配方不对齐的架构（框架）对比不可轻信。

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.
